Our Team

Our team brings together the architects of hyperscale cloud infrastructure, pioneers of flexible AI computing, senior grid scientists, and the executives and diplomats who have shaped global energy policy.

Dr. Varun Sivaram
CEO and Founder

A former Fortune 500 C-suite energy executive, senior U.S. diplomat, Rhodes Scholar, physicist, and author of three books, Dr. Sivaram is one of the world's foremost authorities on energy technologies.

READ FULL BIO
Prof. Ayse Coskun
Chief Scientist

Prof. Coskun, Director of Boston University’s Center for Information and Systems Engineering, has pioneered the field of flexible AI and high-performance computing to bolster the power grid.

READ FULL BIO
Shayan Sengupta
Head of Engineering

Shayan brings two decades of hyperscale cloud, AI, and hardware leadership—from Amazon to Intel—supporting infrastructure powering hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue across mission-critical workloads.

READ FULL BIO
Aroon Vijaykar
Chief Commercial Officer

Aroon brings experience as the chief executive of AEE Solar, head of corporate development at publicly traded Sunrun, and PE investor at Partners Group to lead commercial strategy and partnerships.

READ FULL BIO
Mansi Shah
Head of Product

Mansi Shah is a technology leader with nearly two decades of experience building large-scale data and infrastructure platforms. She previously served as a chief technologist at VMware, where she led enterprise data products and distributed systems initiatives. She brings deep experience in AI infrastructure, energy systems, and complex software platforms.
